18/S0.subgoal: Summarize the various categories of tracking technologies used in VR and AR.

18/S1.subgoal: Describe the characteristics and types of electromechanical trackers.

18/S2.subgoal: Explain how electromagnetic tracking systems operate using stationary transmitters and moving receivers.

18/S3.subgoal: Explain acoustic tracking and how it differs from electromagnetic tracking.

18/S4.subgoal: Identify the three main categories of vision-based tracking.

18/S5.subgoal: Describe infrared tracking techniques, including outside-in and inside-out configurations.

18/S6.subgoal: Explain the three types of visible light tracking: fiducial, natural feature, and model-based tracking.

18/S7.subgoal: Describe 3D structure tracking and how it creates models for augmentation.

18/S8.subgoal: Explain inertial trackers and the primary sensors they utilize.

18/S9.subgoal: Describe other tracking methods such as GPS, motion capture, and eye-tracking.

18/S10.subgoal: Explain the concept of hybrid trackers that combine multiple tracking technologies.

18/S11.subgoal: Summarize the lecture's main points and review the provided references.
